notes.title: Dunjungle Set to Launch Globally on December 11, 2025
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates! 🐒  

It’s been a wild ride since we first dropped Dunjungle into Early Access. Over the past year we’ve patched, polished, and packed the game with tons of new stuff — from wacky bosses to cursed relics to a suspicious amount of bananas. 🍌  

Thanks to YOUR feedback, reviews, and bug reports, Dunjungle has climbed its way to “Overwhelmingly Positive” on Steam. That’s all you, so thank you! 💚  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/97f1e192d3b83b86b11b110eeea584bc1eadf78c.png

Big news: Early Access is coming to an end — the full release launches on December 11, 2025!  

[previewyoutube=ypa4vGvLcqw;full][/previewyoutube]
We’re talking a huge content drop for the 1.0 version, and for the first time ever, Dunjungle will be swinging onto ALL major platforms:  
- PC Steam  
- PlayStation 5 & 4 
- Nintendo Switch 
- Xbox Series X|S 

Oh, and console players can already get a taste — the demo is live on Switch and PlayStation 5 & 4  starting today!  

So grab your relics, sharpen your spears, and get ready to yell at monkeys. 🐒  
See you all in the jungle this December!  

The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: Rolling Shadow Skill, Deadly Bunny, Frenzied Relics & Run Stats!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates!

Dunjungle Version 0.92 is LIVE! Thanks for all the love – now grab your loot and dive in. What's New:

New - Skill:
- Rolling Shadow: Roll forward, becoming immune for the duration of the attack, and dealing damage to enemies in your path.

New - Enemy:
- Did you find the diamond bunny yet? Did you slay it, grabbed the loot, and moved on without consequences? Well we're just gonna say that maybe next time it won't be so easy ;)

New - Rooms:
- Added a slight chance for rooms with powerful monsters from the deepest areas of the game to appear in early biomes as minibosses (the chance increases in higher difficulties)

New - Relics:
- Banana Earring: Consuming Food while you're at Max Health will create an Energy Coat that absorbs 90% of the next hit you take. Avant-garde monkey fashion!
- Spiked Root: Rooted enemies will take 20% more Damage. Don't put it in your pocket! It stings.
- Ring of Frenzy: Attack Speed +100%, but Max Health -50%. Only for reckless button mashers.

New - Run Stats:
- Wonder how much time you have spent exploring the dungeons? How many bosses you defeated perhaps? You can now find Stats in the Hub!

That's it for 0.92! Update now, brave the jungle, and watch out for that bunny...
The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: Critical Mac Save Fix, Gameplay Tweaks & Relic Rebalance!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates!

First and foremost – we've urgently addressed the save file issue on Mac. Don't worry, your progress was never deleted! After updating to v0.91, affected players will be able to recover their saves. This update also includes important gameplay adjustments and relic balancing...



Dunjungle Early Access v0.91 - Patch Notes
Fixes:

- Fixed critical issue for Mac players that made their save file go missing (related to Unity changing it's default save data path)

General Tweaks:

- Player movement: Changes in the Sprint action. Now if you quickly turn around while sprinting, you will keep running on all fours. Also, attacking won't end your sprinting if you keep pressing the directional button.
- Baby Monkey Coin now has a UI indicator to let you know if you have Revives left.
- When you have an active Energy Coat, your Health Bar turns blue to indicate this.
- Updated Joystick button icons for better readability
- Added gamepad support for Stadia Controller
- Switch Pro Controller: Fixed Submit and Cancel buttons (they were inverted)

Relic Balance:

- Idols: Buffed Stat gain (from 10% to 15%)
- Relics that auto-cast spell on melee changed to auto-cast on main weapon attack (so now it works with non-melee main weapons)


As always, stay tuned!

The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: An OP New Class with a New Mysterious Weapon!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates!

How has everyone been experiencing the recent upgrades and updates since the baby monkey's perks & permanent progression? The little ones are now quite useful! This time, we’ve brought a new class and a new weapon!

New Class:

PYRO MONKEY:
Unleash the power of fire!
Less proficient at dealing direct damage, but over-compensates by BURNING IT ALL

New Weapons:

Monkey Buster: Mysterious technology! Shoots lemon-shaped energy projectiles.

General Tweaks:
- Added more Area Layouts to all Dungeons (there were 12 variations, now there are 20!)
- Changed Megaphone effect (baby mascots will attack with your attack, not your interact button)
- Vampire Class: Added a brief immunity period after bat form ends
- Power Up Mode Alternative: Gather 3 to receive a Bonus Stat choice (but the choices you get are much bigger now!)
- Ape Amulet changes: Now it heals a flat amount, rendering it more useful to heal at early game and for classes with low hp
- Bonus Stats Cap is now marked with a color when you reach the maximum number for a Bonus Stat.
- Base Max HP is now 1000, upgradable to 1200 for the basic class.
- A Warp Portal will appear when you beat all enemies in the area, teleporting you directly to the Exit Doors
- Jump Height: Base jump height is now higher
- Heal effect descriptions now consider the Hard and Extra Hard difficulty debuff

Meta-progression perks:
- New unlock: Re-Roll Power Up choices
- New unlock: Re-Roll Ape Amulet Upgrade choices
- Doctor Revive: Starts reviving at 10% hp, unlock more levels to increase the %

Bug fixes:
- Poison Egg damage is now properly counted as Artifact Damage
- Pendant of Pain: Now description is correct, instead of adding 100% damage, it doubles all damage output after all other calculations are done
- Vampire Class Bat Form was getting damage in some cases where it was supposed to be immune to it

As always, stay tuned!

The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: BABY MONKEY PERKS & PERMANENT PROGRESSION Now Live!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates!

We hope you’ve been digging the Abandoned Tunnels and experimenting with our nutty new Engineer Monkey class! Let us know your feedback! But that's not it—today’s update is all about your tiny companions. Yes, the forever loyal Baby Monkeys! 

In the past months, many of you requested a progression system for these adorable critters, and TODAY It is the time to once again SAY HELLO TO YOUR LITTLE FRIEND!

NEW SYSTEM: BABY MONKEY METAPROGRESSION!

 - Level up your Baby Monkeys at the Hub!
Rescue a new Baby Monkey, then find them chilling at the bottom-right corner of the Hub. Each now grants unique perks while in your party!

- Boost their power with Banana Gems!
Spend those shiny pink gems to enhance their buffs further. Pro tip: Feed them well, and they’ll carry you to victory!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/65c08254933e48a5879f92cd9280488486b25056.png
NEW RELICS

Baby Monkey Coin
Whenever your Health reaches 0, instead of dying, a Baby Monkey will heal you and then leave you for the rest of the run.

Megaphone
Make some monkey noises (interact button) to Command your Baby Monkeys. They will immediately execute an attack, skipping the cooldown.

TWEAKS & POLISH

 Ape Amulet charge: The damage needed to charge the amulet will now increase per biome (previously it was increased per amount of enemies killed across the run).
 Patapez Enemy Attack: Reduced the collider's active frame time
 Meta Currency used for permanent upgrades are now Banana Gems
 Biomes: For new players to access the alternative biomes, they first have to complete their counterpart
 Biomes: Now you can access the Abandoned Tunnels via The Crypt (after the beating the boss, of course)
 Bosses: Buffed Ant Queen and Sap Queen max health
 Lucky Charm Relic: Buffed chances of survival (20% -> 25%)
 Ghost Monkey Class: Nerfed Magic Damage Bonus (50% -> 30%). Reduced Immunity Frames in higher difficulties (was 180 frames in all difficulties, now is 180/135/90).
 Difficulty: Reduced the damage and health of the enemies in the first biome.

BUG FIXES

- Fixed very rare game crashing bug related to the skill "Meteor"

That’s BANANAS for now! Rest assured that we’re still jungle-cooking more wild updates before the inevitable Full Release! Thank you for your attention and support!

As always, stay tuned!

The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: Descend into Darkness! The Brand-New Biome "Abandoned Tunnels" Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, Fellow Primates!

A subterranean nightmare awaits — the all-new Abandoned Tunnels biome rises from the depths!

[previewyoutube=PUQVO-42gBI;full][/previewyoutube]
How to Dive into the Dark

Defeat the Sunken Shrine's Boss to unlock a brand-new route and head straight for the underworld!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/cf9a9e5841207d6bec22553f3fddde32b446b019.png

With the Steam Spring Sale kicking off, primates can enjoy 15% off the lowest discounts again! If you've been holding out, now is the perfect time to join us!

Here's a sneak peek of what's coming up!


 New Biome!
The rot seeps deeper. Collapsing tunnels! Nitroglycerin barrels! And whatever you do—just don't touch the glowing eggs…

Fire magic? Bold choice. Just watch out for the powder kegs.

 New Enemies and Threats:
Ant colonies SWARM for their mutated Queen. Watch for special ones—even corrupted, their pheromone commands are flawless.

 New Class and Weapon:

ENGINEER MONKEY
Monke finally earned his engineering degree and equipped himself with proper tools!

Heavy-Duty Wrench
A mysterious object made of metal. Looks useful, but you wonder what for.

 Two Brand-New Bosses:

Another queen! Her pheromones rewrite reality—and her followers' bites rewrite your HP bar.
The other? Said to be a madman among madmen… so good luck.

 New Baby Monke:
Monkeys in each region boast unique traits, but one common trait is shared among them all—they're irresistibly adorable ♥

They've never seen sunlight—and that's why they'll cling to you like mold to damp stone.

Other Updates & Fixes
Tweaks and fixes:

 - Buffed Sap Queen HP
 - Pendant of Pain (Relic): Ghost class will receive double damage now (same as other classes)
 - Victory Immunity: Players now gain brief immunity after defeating a boss to prevent post-victory deaths
 - Fixed a bug that stops you from fully healed
 - Improved Revive Effect: More visible, plus added immunity frames after revival
 - Projectiles & attacks no longer deal damage to you after the enemy is dead
 - Weapons fused with the Shadow modifier: Special attacks will also have chances to be executed twice

🐒 Whether you're collapsing tunnels or being collapsed UPON… that's just engineering, Primates! 🐒

notes.title: Major Update is on the Way 🐒
notes.content:
Hello, Fellow Primates!

It’s been over four months since Dunjungle entered Early Access. During this time, we’ve introduced the [Endless Mode] gameplay, added a new biome—the [Sunken Shrine]—and rolled out over a dozen updates featuring dozens of weapons, skills, and skins. Thank you so much for your incredible support and for joining us on this journey.

You may have noticed it’s been over a month since our last update. Rest assured, we haven’t slowed down. Instead, we’ve been dedicating time to prepare a brand-new biome—and we’re excited to share a sneak peek with you today!

Update Timing:
This major update will go live around next Thursday, March 13th.

What’s New:
The update will feature a complete new biome packed with:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/8016ee7f16a9a42165878ecb48c7d6fdb4040c43.png

 New Biome!
The corrupting force has seeped underground, awakening an eroded subterranean kingdom.
 New Enemies and Threats:
The dwellers of the depths have twisted into monsters, fiercely defending their queen.
 Two Brand New Bosses:
Face a manic Corrupted Ant Queen and a greedy, earth-shaking Miner driven by ambition.
 New Baby Monke:
Monkeys in each region boast unique traits, but one thing unites them all—they’re absolutely adorable ♥

Additionally, Endless Mode will be updated to include the new area, inviting all ape guardians to test their limits against the latest challenges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/2df2e5bab360cfa04b68bfa01b18c06ccd26afc9.png

That’s a sneak peek at the exciting content arriving in the next big update 🐒. This new area will feature stunning art, immersive sound design, and rigorous testing to ensure a polished experience. We’re working hard to deliver something amazing—stay tuned and stay hyped!

The Sunken Shrine area has just gone live, and we hope you enjoy exploring it! With the introduction of new bosses, we’ve also added six new achievements for you to challenge yourself with—don’t forget to give them a try!

Additionally, we've made a few balance adjustments:

notes.title: The Brand-New Biome "Sunken Shrine" Has Surfaced!
notes.content:
Hello, Fellow Primates!

The wait is finally over — the first major update that introduces a whole-new biome, the Sunken Shrine, is officially live!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/27b0a498f6120ee8a4fee06521759e64bed428cf.gif
How to Access the New Biome

Defeat the first chapter Boss to unlock a brand-new route and dive into the depths!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/4e96d11c2769f3e6403f9923b859fb91142ac04e.png

Here’s a sneak peek of what’s waiting for you!


 New Biome!
The corrupting force has reached a mystical underwater world, where whispers of sunken treasures lure adventurers.

Treasure chests are more plentiful beneath the waves than on land.A Small Tip: if you’re exploring water-filled areas, Electricity Enchantment will be your best friend!

 New Enemies and Threats:
Monsters lurk beneath the water’s surface, and ancient ruins are riddled with natural traps.

Tentacles everywhere! Ancient statues! And don’t be surprised if you see flying sea creatures, because birds are really just swimming through the air, after all!

 Two Brand-New Bosses:
"Rumor has it there’s a frog in the forest claiming to be king. Ruling over a POND doesn’t make one a monarch…"

One of the bosses is a powerful warrior from the depths, while the other is... well, something indescribable so we’ll leave that for you to discover!

 New Baby Monke:
Monkeys in each region boast unique traits, but one thing unites them all—they’re irresistibly adorable ♥

No more spoilers here—just know that these little monkeys are adorable, and who knows, they might even grow stronger over time!

Of course, as mentioned last time, Endless Mode has also been updated to include those new ocean creatures as well as the land beneath the sea, so don’t miss the chance to test your skills against them!

With the Steam Winter Sale currently underway, our primates are enjoying some of the lowest discounts ever! If you’ve been holding out, now is the perfect time to join us!

🐒 Whether you’re becoming a fish’s meal or feasting on seafood, the choice is yours, Primates!🐒

notes.title: An OP New Class with a New Evil Weapon!
notes.content:
New Class - Ghost Monkey

Now you’ve got an even better reason to take down that annoying ghost! ;)
Ghost Monkey is immune to all environmental hazards, and even the strongest hits will barely scratch him. But... at what cost?

New Weapon - Ghost Scepter

Trap the souls of your foes, and use them to gain power.
The starting weapon for the new Ghost Monkey class—but of course it is unlockable for all!

New Mechanism -Element Interactions: 

 Now Electricity deals more damage to enemies touching water. Electricity also stuns enemies much faster when they are in water. 
 Burn effects no longer apply to enemies touching water.

Balance Tweaks:

 Weapon - Crow Staff: Increased damage.
 Class - Warrior Bear: Lifesteal effects are now half as effective.
 Normal Mode: Slightly longer immunity frames after taking damage.
 Hard Mode: Default immunity frames duration is now set at 50% of the Normal Mode instead of completely removed.
 Immunity Indicator: Added an aura to show when the main character has immunity.
 Blacksmith: Now informs you if there are no weapons to upgrade.
 Statue Curse Aura Color: Changed to orange to avoid confusion with enemy attack auras.
 Final boss: Removed knockback from Spikes attack, avoiding getting hit in chain
 Final boss: Laser attack was not disabling if killed while executing it

Bug Fixes:

Fixed the water "splashing" sound playing even when SFX volume was set to 0.

notes.title: The First Major Update is on the Way 🐒
notes.content:
Hello, Fellow Primates!

Since the Early Access launch of Dunjungle, we’ve been rolling out weekly updates, introducing a number of classes, weapons, and relics to aid in the fight to defend the forest. Recently, we even added an Endless Mode to challenge the unrelenting forces of corruption.

Your incredible support and feedback have inspired us, and from this week, we’re pausing our regular update schedule to focus on preparing a brand-new biome for the next major update.

Here’s a preview of what’s coming:

Release Timing:

The major update is set to go live around Christmas, approximately December 25, coinciding with the Steam Winter Sale and a new discount period.

What’s New:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/f0f90ce5fe1b3a082c306c670fbc2aa18577a3f7.png

 New Biome!
The corrupting force has reached a mystical underwater world, where whispers of sunken treasures lure adventurers.
 New Enemies and Threats:
Monsters lurk beneath the water’s surface, and ancient ruins are riddled with natural traps.
 Two Brand New Bosses:
"Rumor has it there’s a frog in the forest claiming to be king. Ruling over a pond doesn’t make one a monarch…"
 New Baby Monke:
Monkeys in each region boast unique traits, but one thing unites them all—they’re absolutely adorable ♥
 Additionally, Endless Mode will be updated to include the new area, inviting all ape guardians to test their limits against the latest challenges!

notes.title: GET READY FOR ANOTHER NEW CLASS, WEAPON, AND RELICS!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates!

Here are the Patch Notes for the 0.1.8 version:

NEW CLASS - Panda Chef
Big, cute, and always hungry. This class is for food lovers, the more you eat, the more powerful you are!

New Weapons
- Bamboo Katana: Graceful blade hidden in a bamboo sheath. Draws quickly for a technical two-hit slash!

New Relics
- Yin Ring:
Hitting an enemy with a Skill will increase your next Main Weapon's Attack damage by 10% (stackable up to 200%).
- Yang Ring
Hitting an enemy with your Main Weapon will increase your next Skill's Attack damage by 10% (stackable up to 200%).

Tweaks:
- All King Frogus minions will die immediately when you beat him
- Buffed Katana Special Attack Damage
- Primal Monkey Class: Added Drill Punch as the Special Attack for the naked fist (execute this new move by pressing the attack button while rolling)
- Shell Gauntlet: Added "Drill" as a Special Attack (while rolling)
- Weapons that passively trigger Berserk (Claws, Greataxe, Club, Fist) will now increase Attack Speed at a slower pace (still reaching the same final attack speed after N attacks)
- Annoying Ghost is a bit less annoying now! Reduced Health (-20%). 

Bug Fixes:
- Sometimes healing was not recovering your Health to 100%, remaining instead at Full Health minus 1
- Primal Monkey Class: Was still getting Weapon Drops from Bosses


Hope you enjoy the new changes :)
The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: NEW CLASS, NEW RELICS!
notes.content:
Hey Fellow Primates!

Here are the Patch Notes for the 0.1.7 version:

NEW CLASS - Primal Monkey

Who needs fancy weapons? This is the unga bunga mode! 
You will be able to rely only on your naked fists (and maybe some rocks and sticks).

NEW RELICS
We want to encourage you to try diverse builds, so we're adding more Relics with synergies for a variety of styles!

Wind-up Toy: Increases your Movement Speed while you're charging a Special Attack

Sword Ornament: Special Attacks from your Main Weapon deal more damage.

Stone Glove: Increases your Damage by 50% of your Bonus Defense.

Elementalist Hat: Attacks that inflict Burn, Slow, or Stun will deal more damage.

Focus Glasses: Add 15 True Damage to every instance of damage dealt to enemies (True Damage is flat, and doesn't scale with your Stats).

Settings:

Game Resolution can now be changed from the Settings Menu (from a dropdown of 16:9 resolutions)

Tweaks

Count Monkula - The "pillars" attack is now evadable by rolling!
Dodge: If you auto-dodge an attack (instead of by rolling) a "Lucky" message will appear.
Endless Mode: After each cycle, the enemies will get a bit stronger than before.


Hope you enjoy the new changes :)
The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: "Endless Mode" is Here Along with the Leaderboard Support!
notes.content:
Early Access Patch Note - V0.1.5

Fellow Primates,

Thank you for your patience! Told you we are cooking something BIG and here we are! Happy to deliver the all-new Endless Mode today as the very first game mode update post-Early Access launch!

Check it out!

All-New Endless Mode
This brand new mode is for you, hardcore players!
- Play through an infinite cycle of combat rooms. Careful as you progress, as enemies and bosses will get stronger every cycle.
- Steam Leaderboard is now supported alongside the new Endless Mode. Now your Best Run Times and Max Endless Floors Conquered will be submitted and shown on Steam!

Class Balancing
- Dino Berserker: Buffed Retaliate damage reduction.
- Dino Berserker: Buffed Retaliate damage output.
- Dino Berserker: After Retaliate, you will get a few immunity frames.
- Dino Berserker: If you activate Retaliate while moving, it will mimic the usual Dodge Roll movement.
- Dino Berserker: Bosses won't drop Secondary Weapons.
- Dino Berserker: Shaman won't appear, as you can't use the Ape Amulet.
- Sorcerer Frog: Will emit Typhoons when executing Ground Pound.
- Sorcerer Frog: Buffed Max Health (50% -> 60% of base Max Health).
- Master Dog: Buffed chances to summon random creature on melee kill (50% -> 100%).
- Master Dog: Buffed lifetime of summons (+25% -> +50%).
- Warrior Bear: Removed initial speed reduction debuff.
- Warrior Bear: Speed bonuses during the run will be reduced by 50%.
- Warrior Bear: Greatly buffed Heavy Roll damage scaling with Max Health (100% -> 300%).

Overall Difficulty Adjustment
- Bosses in Extra Hard difficulty are faster now.
- Final Boss - Meteors attack buffed.

General
- Defense stat capped at 60%.
- Biome name will appear when you enter a new biome.
- Lowered volume of swarm/beehive summons loop sound.
- Added more enemy combinations in arena rooms.

Bugs Fixes:
- Killstreak timer goes down in some peaceful rooms like the mask fusion room.
- The "Flying Bomb" enemy might not trigger death animation if killed too fast on spawn.


The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: A NEW CLASS, A NEW WEAPON, MORE RELIC SLOTS, AND NERF BAT FOR KING FROGUS!
notes.content:
Fellow Primates,

Thank you for the overwhelming support and feedback! We’ve carefully reviewed your suggestions, and this patch addresses several gameplay improvements, while introducing some VERY EXCITING new stuff coming into the game - and that is only a beginning!

New Class: Master Dog!

 Love summoning creatures? With Master Dog, you can focus your build around Summons and Familiars, unleashing their full potential!

notes.title: Dunjungle Roadmap: Exciting Updates Ahead!
notes.content:
Fellow Primates!🐒

We’re thrilled to share our roadmap for upcoming updates to Dunjungle! We’ve been listening to your feedback and are committed to enhancing your adventure with a host of new features and content. Here’s what you can look forward to:

More Weapon Types⚔️
To make each adventure more thrilling, we’ll be introducing additional primary and secondary weapons for players to unlock. Expect a mix of powerful weapons and those with fun, unique mechanics that will add variety and depth to your gameplay experience.

More Relics💎
We’re designing a wider array of relics to cater to different build preferences. These new relics will not only facilitate the assembly of powerful builds but also encourage players to explore creative strategies, making each playthrough unique.

More Classes👗
In addition to the three current classes, we’re hard at work creating new, powerful, and adorable costumes! Stay tuned for some exciting reveals coming VERY SOON!

New Maps🗺️
We’re planning to design and develop many more distinct levels for players to tackle. These new maps will feature diverse landscapes, unique enemies, and challenging bosses to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging.

New Bosses🦹
In addition to the new bosses that will appear on upcoming maps, we’ll be adding more bosses to existing levels. This will further enhance the game’s variety and depth, offering new challenges for seasoned players.

New Functional Rooms🏰
Get ready for new functional rooms with corresponding NPCs during your adventures! These will provide additional opportunities to adjust your build, including options to upgrade weapon rarity and re-roll weapon stats.

Compendium + Bestiary!📖🐉
We’ll be adding a compendium and a bestiary, allowing players to track all the weapons, relics, enemies, and bosses they’ve encountered on their journey. This will help you keep track of your adventures and aim for completion!

We’re excited about these upcoming features and can’t wait for you to experience them. Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we work to make Dunjungle the best it can be!

The Dunjungle Team
Oct.28, 2024

notes.title: Early Access Patch Note V0.1.2
notes.content:
Oct.26, 2024

Fellow Primates,

Thanks a lot for your timely feedback across different channels; we have taken action to address some of your concerns and suggestions! 

Please find the following updates to Dunjungle in this patch.

Additional Balance/Difficulty Tweaks

 Expanded the Liana (Whip) hitbox - now it hits enemies that are close to the player-controlled character;
 Increased the default jump height of the player slightly;
 Slightly increased the hitbox length of all primary weapons;
 Tutorial - Fight sequence: Reduced the frequency of enemies spawning, and made the combat area bigger;
 Reduced the number of enemies spawned in the Easy Combat Rooms in the first biome - Jungle;
 Added a projectile attack to the Necromancer enemy in the second biome - Crypt;
 Added more zombie monkeys in the Idol Room in second biome - Crypt;


Enhanced "Revive" Mechanism

 Revive: Added shockwaves that knock enemies back at the timing of Revive
 Revive: Enhanced the visual effects of reviving - Now it's super obvious! 
 Revive: Difficulty healing debuff won't affect Revive's health recovery
 Revive: Added a GUI indicator when Revive is unlocked and available


Some Other Important Bug Fixes!

 Monkey respawn scene: Reduced duration
 Added Celebratory Message when you beat the game in the Extra Hard difficulty
 After clearing Hard difficulties, player is now correctly returned to the Hub, not the Main Menu (there's still content to discover!)
 Added an outline to the Shaman Baboon in the first room of the run to make it stand out more
 Pacifist Achievement: Only the damage made by the player will be taken into account for the achievement
 Added a Skip button to the Credits scene after you have seen it for the first time


We'll continue to do our best to polish Dunjungle in order to present it to you in its best form in the future full release. Thanks again for your continued support!

The Dunjungle Team

notes.title: [Big Update] New Demo, and Publisher announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

I'm super thrilled to announce that Astrolabe Games will be publishing Dunjungle!
This relationship will allow me to focus 100% on the development of the game, helping make Dunjungle the best that it can be.

Having said that, I'm also excited to share a MAJOR update in the demo! Here you can find a list of what's new since the last update:


 LOCALIZATION - More languages are available! English, Spanish, Chinese (simplified and traditional), and Japanese.
 WEAPON SPECIAL ATTACKS - ALL primary weapons received were updated! Hold the attack button to execute each weapon Special Attack.
 EQUIPMENT RARITY SYSTEM - Now you can find different versions of each Weapon and Skill! Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary. Increasing the quality and adding stat bonuses.
 PERMANENT PROGRESSION - Putting the 'T' in 'RogueliTe', Dunjungle now offers permanent upgrades that you can progressively unlock to increase your power for your following incursions.
 FAMILIARS - You can now find and rescue [spoiler]BABY MONKEYS[/spoiler] that will follow you around and help you for the rest of the run.
 NEW EQUIPMENT - Loads of new Relics with cool effects to enhance your strategies, and new weapons to use.
 ENEMIES - New Rooms and new enemies to fight.
 INPUT SYSTEM - You can now customize your inputs. Keyboard and Gamepad.


There's also a Survey link on the main menu. Feel free to complete it for general feedback on the game, or as always, you can also contact me or post in the Community hub.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41621351/e5a3fe5516c4992395e25e4bd68694a51f8a7630.png


That's all for today.
Hope you enjoy the new content!

notes.title: Dunjungle's New Demo!
notes.content:
Hey! I'm Bruno, the developer of Dunjungle.

In this fast paced 2d action roguelite, you'll play as an ape, adventuring into ancient jungle temples.

Some of the things you'll do:
- Gather cool weapons and relics
- Fight shady temple dudes and creatures
- Meet lovely NPCs
- Die a bunch of times (and then die some more)

You'll get many doors to choose from. 
The dangers and rewards you're presented will change according to the paths you choose. So do it carefully!

But enough reading now. Go to the game page and hit that download button!

After playing, join our Discord here and let me know what you think about the game!
